$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target (.ds-accordion) and how to read it. skip: spec keys not compared for this layer.

root.$why: Figma puts the items in an "items" slot inside the Accordion; the code has one box, so the gap between items is compared on "items".

Divider.$why: Figma's Divider is a 0 px line at the item's bottom edge; the code draws it as a 1 px inset shadow on the item, so only its colour is compared (the pixels cover its place).

items.$why: Figma's items slot is the Accordion's own box in code: its gap is the gap between items.
